title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side
tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

faults.what: The photos have been altered rather than simply fitted into the layout. Both panels show additional lower cabinetry and flooring absent from the supplied photos, and the original framing and cabinet proportions have changed.
The finished canvas is approximately 1024×564, slightly wider than the requested 16:9 ratio.

judge.summary: The comparison has clear labels and the correct left-to-right order, but it changes the supplied photos instead of preserving them.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
must_haves.why: There is one side-by-side comparison, but the canvas is not exactly 16:9 and the panels are altered versions of the supplied photos.

must_haves.item: The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
must_haves.why: The kitchens are arranged in the requested order.

must_haves.item: The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: Both labels are correctly spelled, readable, and fully visible above their respective panels.

must_haves.item: Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.
must_haves.why: The original photos are not preserved intact: the output introduces lower scene content and changes the framing and proportions.
